title: Language Integrated Query (LINQ)
summary: LINQ is language-integrated query: query syntax and method syntax compile to the same operators. Deferred execution is the production trap on hot paths. IEnumerable runs delegates in process; IQueryable builds expression trees for a provider. This module stays at interview level — no Entity Framework Core course.

topics.title: Query syntax versus method syntax (two spellings of LINQ)
Standard operators: SelectMany, grouping, and joining (LINQ transforms)
Deferred execution and hot-path traps (plan vs run)
IEnumerable versus IQueryable (delegates vs expression trees)
LINQ to Objects versus remote query providers (in-memory vs server)
